name: The Doors (cambridgetcg.github.io)
owner: not recorded; README.md names no lane (it says how to update the doors with tools/assemble.py)
waits_on: an owner's word for a kit: no lane, ledger item or decision names one for the hall

decided.what: paper #f6f1e7, ink #2b241c, lamp #b5651d, card #fbf7ef; dark #17140f, ink #ece3d3, lamp #e0a050; ui-serif and Georgia
decided.record: commit 0fb50083 ('Bring the public doors back as public copies', 2026-10-09; git author 'YOU', co-author 'The Fable of the Eternal Universe') brought the hall in index.html and 404.html; whether a person or an agent chose its look is not recorded

deploy.on_merge: Every push to main runs .github/workflows/pages.yml: it builds the Jekyll doors with GitHub's Pages builder, copies static/ and the named root files (index.html, 404.html, doors.json, robots.txt), refuses hidden files and anything tools/guard.py flags, scans with gitleaks, and deploys GitHub Pages.
deploy.after_deploy: door-watch.yml runs tools/door_contract.py daily at 06:17 UTC; it reports PASS, FAIL or NOT CHECKED and always exits 0.
deploy.rules: README.md: each door under jekyll/ and static/ is a public copy of a private repository's page and keeps that page's own look, so only the hall (index.html, 404.html) is dressed here. Personal pages and citizen pages wait for a separate decision.

notes: Serving: the kit's files would be committed at the repository root (serve.to) and copied into _site by pages.yml (serve.via), which copies named root files only, so its `cp index.html 404.html doors.json robots.txt _site/` line needs them added. With a kit, run `node brand/check.mjs --served _site` after that step. brand/ is not on that list, so it isn't published.

check.mjs is not wired yet; planned: a step `node brand/check.mjs` in .github/workflows/pages.yml before the build (the repository's unit tests run only in door-watch.yml, as `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`).
Today the hall has no favicon, theme-color or share card: /favicon.ico answers 404 (2026-11-05), and the live hall is byte-size identical to main's index.html (16,608 bytes).
A root /favicon.ico would also become the fallback icon for every door under this host that declares none, so check the doors' own icons before adding one.
